color.$description: Raw palette. Pieces never use these directly; use the semantic roles.

white.$description: Pure white. Only for surface.raised (controls that sit on top of a surface). Not a third page surface.

neutral.$description: Cool neutral ramp. Kept deliberately small; no two steps within ~4 hex points.

com.diegoeis.eis-ds.source: author's choice, 2026-10-25 (was #e6e6e6, sampled from docs/visual-guidance/references/interface main-1..3)

200.$description: Data visualisation only: lowest step of the chart ramp (200 · 400 · 600 · 900). Never a surface or a text colour.

400.$description: Data visualisation only: second step of the chart ramp. Never a surface or a text colour.

com.diegoeis.eis-ds.source: was #bdbdbd; darkened 2026-10-25 so adjacent ramp steps differ by ≥1.8:1

500.$description: Mid grey. Icons, placeholders and other non-text graphics (3.5:1 on neutral.0, passes the 3:1 for UI graphics). Not for body text.

600.$description: Secondary ink. 4.8:1 on neutral.100, 5.4:1 on neutral.0.

900.$description: Primary ink and inverse surface. 15.7:1 on neutral.100.

500.$description: Accent. Marks a state or the one thing that matters; <=5% of the area. Fails as text on light surfaces (3.1:1); put neutral.900 on it (5.6:1), never white.

com.diegoeis.eis-ds.source: docs/visual-guidance/references/palette/orange-circles-grid.png, flat fill sampled exactly; chosen by the author 2026-10-25 over the TE median #f15033

700.$description: Accent when it has to BE text on light surfaces. Same hue as orange.500, darkened. 4.7:1 on neutral.100, 5.3:1 on neutral.0.

green.$description: Status colour for success. Not a second accent: it only confirms a state.

500.$description: Success fill: done, saved, sent. Fails as text on light surfaces (2.9:1 on neutral.100); put neutral.900 on it (5.5:1), never white (3.5:1).

700.$description: Success when it has to BE text on light surfaces. Same hue as green.500, darkened. 4.8:1 on neutral.100, 5.4:1 on neutral.0.
